note: Multiplex gain only if read noise is additive/ADC-limited, not shot noise; ADC amortization over 16 tiers is the real win.
A 5 um string at c/50 spans under 1 ps, far below 20 ps pulse resolution; meanders would eat the density gain.
AC/lock-in sensing rejects DC leakage but not its shot noise; demodulation cycles add read latency.
Three orthogonal plane-gate families cannot coexist without intersecting; data path and bandwidth per access unclear.
Resistive gate gradient plus anti-ambipolar window device; static pillar current and window variability across 64 tiers are risks.
Bandgap absorption is an edge, not a band: low-gap tiers absorb all shorter wavelengths, so selectivity is poor.
MRAM-style destructive self-reference; known technique, trades 2x latency and write energy for tolerating Vt spread.
Tone-mixing addressing is clever, but sneak paths through on-state diodes are also nonlinear and mix; SNR doubtful.
Self-verifying tier address via end-current ratio; resistive line degrades read signal, niche reliability benefit.
Wafer-scale grain mapping in minutes and multi-beam writing per die are expensive and slow; concept is non-obvious.
Buckled-beam NEMS memory has been proposed; sealed cavities per tier limit density, resonance read is slow.
Vertical racetrack is IBM's original concept; NV metrology adds little novelty, shift reliability unsolved.
Ferroelastic switching endurance and fatigue are poor; resembles strain/piezoelectronic memory proposals.
LiNbO3 domain-wall memory already demonstrated in research; tier stacking of LNOI needs bonding.
CuMnAs/Mn2Au and altermagnetic MTJs widely pursued; tiny read signal remains the blocker.
Write-termination on current knee is known for RRAM/MRAM; reasonable application to FBC/thyristor tiers.
Qualification metrics for capacitorless cells could ease adoption; executable but incremental.
Standard APC feedforward applied per tier with corona-Kelvin metrology; modest uniformity gain.
Witness structures known; per-tier witnesses could relax thermal guard bands in monolithic stacks.
Measured random contact-to-tier map removes staircase; holes through upper tiers need isolation and risk shorts.
Electronic steering echoes Sun proximity-communication alignment; misaligned hybrid-bond pads risk shorting neighbors.
